facts.fact: MEA apostilles educational documents such as degrees, diplomas and matriculation/secondary certificates
facts.quote: Apostille is done for personal documents like birth/death/marriage certificates, Affidavits, Power of Attorney, etc. and educational documents like degree, diploma, matriculation and secondary level certificates etc.

facts.fact: An apostille is accepted in all member countries of the Hague Apostille Convention
facts.quote: Apostille is acceptable in all member-countries of the Convention

facts.fact: India has been a member of the Hague Apostille Convention since 2005
facts.quote: India, since 2005, is a member of the Hague Convention of October 5 1961 that abolished the requirement of legalization of foreign public documents.

facts.fact: For countries that are not members of the Hague Convention, 'normal attestation' is done instead
facts.quote: This is done for all the countries which are not a member of Hague Convention and where Apostille is not accepted.

facts.fact: Step 1 (documents not covered under e-Sanad): get the document authenticated by the designated Regional Authentication Centre (RAC) of the State/UT; the RAC list is on the MEA site
facts.quote: Step 1. Authentication of Documents Applicant Regional Authentication Centres (RACs) Details of RACs is available at following link

facts.fact: For educational documents the RAC is usually the State education/HRD department
facts.note: MEA's apostille page and its RAC list (mea.gov.in/images/RAC_Updated_DATA.pdf) list State-wise RACs (Home/GAD, protocol, education, examination boards and others) but no MEA page says educational documents usually go to the education/HRD department; the bot should point to the State's RAC list instead.

facts.fact: Step 2: deposit the document with one of MEA's authorised outsourced service providers: BLS International, Superb Enterprises, IVS Global Services or Alhind Tours & Travels
facts.quote: Details of Four Outsource Agency center is available at following link M/s BLS International Services Ltd. 161 KB M/s Superb Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. 395 KB M/s IVS Global Services Private Ltd. 177 KB M/s Alhind Tours & Travels Pvt. Ltd.

facts.fact: The original document is submitted to the service provider with a photocopy of the document and a photocopy of the applicant's passport
facts.quote: The original document/true copy is to be submitted directly to any of the five outsourced service providers along with a photocopy of the document and a photocopy of the Passport of the applicant.

facts.fact: Attestation/apostille services were decentralised to Branch Secretariats/RPOs in 16 cities from 1 January 2019
facts.quote: W.e.f. January 01 2019, Attestation/Apostille services have been decentralized to Branch Secretariats/RPOs in 16 cities

facts.fact: MEA does not accept documents directly from individuals
facts.quote: no document is directly accepted from individuals at the Ministry of External Affairs Counter at CPV Division, Patiala House Annexe, New Delhi.
It would be pertinent to point out that the Ministry does not legalize photocopies.

facts.fact: Step 3: collect the apostilled document from the outsourced agency
facts.quote: Step 3. Receipt of apostilled/Attested documents from Outsource agencies.

facts.fact: Documents available in a digital repository (e.g. CBSE documents from 2014 onwards) are apostilled online through e-Sanad
facts.quote: The e-Sanad service will start with CBSE depository (documents of years 2014 & onwards) and verification of these CBSE documents would be done online.
The link for e-Sanad portal is : http://esanad.nic.in.

facts.fact: MEA's fee is Rs 50 per apostille (per apostille sticker)
facts.quote: Apostille Rs 50 per apostille sticker Rs 84 per document Rs. 3 per page

facts.fact: Normal attestation by MEA is free of cost
facts.quote: Normal Attestation is done free of cost.

facts.fact: The outsourced agency's service charge is Rs 84 per document
facts.quote: Apostille Rs 50 per apostille sticker Rs 84 per document Rs. 3 per page

facts.fact: The outsourced agency's scanning charge is Rs 3 per page
facts.quote: Apostille Rs 50 per apostille sticker Rs 84 per document Rs. 3 per page

facts.fact: MEA warns applicants not to rely on unauthorised persons or touts
facts.quote: Applicants are advised not to rely on unauthorised persons/touts for Apostille or Attestation services.

behaviour: Gives the procedure and fee only as on mea.gov.in 'Attestation / Apostille' (and its e-Sanad and RAC documents), with citation; points to the State/UT's RAC in MEA's RAC list rather than naming a department; passportindia.gov.in is not available to the bot and is not needed.
fail_if: Says MEA accepts walk-in documents; quotes agent/third-party package prices; omits State RAC authentication; omits the agency service charge; invents a processing time; states as a rule that educational documents always go to the State education/HRD department.
summary: MEA apostille page (updated 22 Oct 2026) confirms procedure, agencies, Rs 50 + Rs 84 + Rs 3/page and e-Sanad; the 'usually State education/HRD department' RAC claim is not on any MEA page.
